d:
Dharavahik- dekh tamasha dekh
Kahani- aa bail mujhe mar
Lekhak,nirmata,nirdeshak- rajan kumar aahuja
Jivan anmol hai,ise yun hi dhene men nahin urana chahie | dekh tamasha dekh ki kahani aa bail mujhe mar ise charitarth karti hai | dhrumpan sehat ke lie janleva hai,ise samajhna jaruri hai | thori-si jankari aur sehat ke prati sajagta insan ki zindagi ko bacha pati hai | dhrumpan ke prati sachet karti yah natak logon men jagrukta jagane ka kam karti hai |
